_comment: COPY THIS FILE TO YOUR VAULT ROOT as moodle-mirror.json (paths above resolve from the vault root). It is the MIRROR config only. The DOWNLOAD config is separate: moodle-sync/config.json belongs to moodle-dl (keys: moodle_domain, moodle_path, download_course_ids, token) and is created by 'moodle-dl --init'. save_token.py writes the token there. Leave downloader empty for sync-only mode (no pull, mirror existing snapshot only).
